nws.synopsis: Lingering scattered showers will bring light rain to areas west of the mountains today, becoming more confined to San Diego County this evening. Weak offshore flow expected Saturday and Sunday. Dry and warmer for the weekend through Monday, then gradually cooler for the middle of next week with a chance of precipitation for late next week. Tides will increase over the weekend, remaining elevated through much of next week.
systems: By tonight, models are showing a closed upper level low moving south and east towards the border of California and Arizona.
This will turn the pressure gradient weakly offshore, increasing north to northeasterly winds in wind prone locations.
Given the unsettled weather quickly turning to offshore flow, marine layer low clouds and fog will largely be absent from the coast into early next week.

nws.aviation: 240530Z...Generally VFR conditions across the region, though -SHRA/SHRA will continue off and on for the next few hours in portions of San Diego County and in the Coachella Valley. Low clouds based 3-7 kft will slowly SCT overnight with SKC expected across the region by sunrise Sat. N/NE winds gusting 25-35 kts develop starting 06-09z through (and south of) the Cajon Pass and along south-facing mountain slopes. Winds weaken and eventually diminish Saturday afternoon and evening.

sites.name: Little Black
sites.note: Best post-frontal site in the county. West-facing, so offshore mornings are over the back.

sites.name: Blossom Valley
sites.note: Inland thermal site; often lines up with Elsinore.

sites.name: Elsinore (E / Edwards)
sites.note: East-facing over the lake; its own animal. The sea-breeze convergence line is the XC engine.

sites.name: Torrey Pines
sites.note: Ridge soaring in a steady W to WNW sea breeze. Rare thermal days (1,200 ft+) are flagged as a Thermal day.

sites.name: Laguna / Horse
sites.note: Mountain convergence: needs onshore SW at launch and no north or east wind aloft.

sites.name: Otay
sites.note: Near the border; XC goes north and east.

sites.name: Soboba
sites.note: Flight park on the San Jacinto front.

sites.name: Santa Barbara (Skyport)
sites.note: South-facing front range above Santa Barbara. Sundowners and other north winds are over the back.
